compute_mps: compute monomial potentials (rkkks, ramkks, rbmkks) from ABC tensors using einsum operations
construct_bases: construct a d-by-d complex Fourier basis matrix from roots of unity
load_model_traj: load a series of model checkpoint files and extract ABC weight tensors in Fourier space
process_one: process a single model output folder by loading checkpoints, computing monomial potentials, and returning results
run_modular_addition_analysis: run parallel analysis across multiple model output folders and save aggregated results to results.pth
